thread:
Alex P: Hey team — quick handoff for the 10:30 UTC rollout (inference service v2). Posting a compact checklist and who takes each lane. Please reply with ✅ or call out blockers.

Checklist (short):
- Deploy start: 2026-03-17 10:30 UTC
- Canary lanes: blue (5%) / green (25%) / full (100%)
- Health smoke: readiness, p50/p95 latency, error-rate <= 0.5%
- Rollback hook and owner identified
- Console dashboards pinned + alerts enabled
- Post-rollout verification prompts (sanity prompt set)

Lane owners:
- blue (5%) -> Alex P (initial smoke)
- green (25%) -> Riya S (metrics & canary evaluation)
- full -> Marta L (final cutover)

Rollback owner: Jin W (will execute rollback if error spike or KV corruption observed).
Monitoring & alerts: Samir K will watch dashboards and notify SRE channel if anything crosses thresholds.

Rollback command (if needed):
```
# rollback to previous stable revision
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --to-revision=stable
# or via k8s job: ./ops/run-rollback --service inference-runtime --rev stable
```

Feature flag toggle (traffic switch):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.prod/api/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"flag":"inference_v2","state":"on","percent":25}'
```

Notes:
- Keep canaries at least 10m each unless metrics look very clean.
- If latency p95 rises > 150ms over baseline for >3m, stop and rollback.
- No schema migrations in this deploy. DB-safe.

Riya S: ✅ I can take green lane. I'll start the smoke runner and post the report to this thread. Will watch p95 and 5xx.

Marta L: I can own final cutover. Will not start full traffic until Riya + Alex thumbs up.

Jin W: Acknowledged for rollback. I have the playbook linked here: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollbacks#inference-runtime. If we need to rollback, ping me and I'll run the commands and update this thread.

Samir K: I'll be on watch and in #eng-sre. I'll set a short-lived alert rule for p95 and error-rate and post the Grafana link.

Alex P: Two quick asks: 1) @devex verify the canary prompt set is uploaded to the runner (Riya, can you confirm). 2) @security quick check that no new env var leaks in the image (Marta, any changes?).

Riya S: Canary prompt set is uploaded (tag: canary-suite-20260317). Running a dry smoke now — will share results in ~5m.

Marta L: No env changes in this image. Build reproduced from CI with identical env. :+1:

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: inference-runtime-v2 scheduled at 2026-03-17T10:30:00Z. Watcher: Samir K. CI status: all green.

Alex P: If dry smoke looks clean, I'll kick blue lane at T+0, then green at T+10m, full at T+25m assuming okay. Call out any objections now.

Riya S: Dry smoke passed basic checks. p50 ~ 34ms, p95 ~ 78ms, error-rate 0.03%. I'll start the canary runner on green lane at T+10m.

Samir K: Alert rules applied: p95_delta > 150ms or error_rate > 0.5% over sliding 3m will fire to #eng-sre and call on-call.

Jin W: Quick reminder — if we need an emergency rollback, I'm online for the next 90 minutes. Also ensure we don't delete canary logs (keeps) until end of window.

Marta L: No objections. Go for it.

Alex P: Starting blue lane now. I'll post checkpoints here every 5m.

Riya S: Green canary started. Watchlist: top-10 prompts, latency histograms, GPU mem tail.

Samir K: Seeing a 0.2% transient spike at +6m but it resolved. No action yet.

Alex P: Blue looks stable at +10m. p95 +22ms vs baseline, error-rate steady. Proceeding to green.

Riya S: Green steady at +15m. p95 +30ms, error-rate 0.04%. No anomalous traces. Recommend proceeding to full at T+25m.

Marta L: Preparing full cutover now. I'll hold until Riya + Alex confirm final thumbs.

Alex P: Thumbs up. Riya ok?

Riya S: Thumbs up. Proceed to full.

Marta L: Rolling full traffic to v2. Monitoring closely.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% traffic at 2026-03-17T10:58:12Z. Check dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/inference/runtime-overview

Samir K: Post-deploy quick checks: p95 85ms, errors 0.05%. No alerts fired.

Jin W: No rollback needed. I'll keep standby for 30m.

Alex P: Thanks everyone — logging the rollout summary into the release doc and closing the window. If you spot any oddness, please @channel. :party-parrot:
